name: Major M. A. Jalil
contribution: Major M. A. Jalil commanded Sector 9 of the Mukti Bahini during the Liberation War.
context: The sector covered the southwestern riverine region, where his forces coordinated land resistance with operations around waterways and coastal routes.
impact: His command helped sustain pressure on Pakistani positions and protect strategic corridors in the south.
highlight: A commanding figure in complex riverine-war conditions.
